structure.unit: Virginia Birth-Related Neurological Injury Compensation Act

law.catch_line: Right to confront and cross-examine witnesses
law.text: Upon a timely motion, all parties to a claim under this chapter shall have the right to confront and cross-examine witnesses. In pursuing that right, a party shall not be precluded from conducting depositions by oral examination or cross-examination at a hearing of any witnesses from whom evidence is elicited.
